exposure_geometry.interpretation: The complete book is materially net long in every period and its signed time-weighted exposure is almost entirely long US30, despite meaningful gross US100 occupancy. This satisfies the exposure half of the mechanism but does not establish return attribution.

daily_market_attribution.interpretation: Only about ten percent of pooled daily stressed-return variance is explained by the frozen signed market composite, below the twenty-percent pooled gate and with only two qualifying periods. Favorable index drift is therefore not a sufficient daily mechanism account of portfolio results.

drawdown_matched_passive_hurdles.interpretation: Neither risk-matched passive benchmark beat actual strategy net in any period. The signed benchmark also failed to beat even the optimistic stressed comparison in every period.

strategy_excess.interpretation: Actual strategy net per unit of Tester equity drawdown exceeded both passive efficiencies by the required margin in every period and pooled.

drawdown_basis.interpretation: The equity-versus-balance drawdown gap is not broad or large enough to change the repository's portfolio risk-basis requirements.

serialization_note: The one successful Python aggregation printed Infinity for positive-advantage concentration because there was no positive signed advantage. The frozen result represents this undefined value as JSON null without recomputing any economic value; the benchmark gate already fails its zero wins and negative pooled advantage conditions.

preserve: the current absolute portfolio economics and existing scoped unit verdicts
the present research gates without a mandatory passive-hurdle or equity-DD rule change
all six components and current construction as research evidence
discard: the claim that favorable US30/US100 drift materially explains the complete portfolio's daily return path
the claim that either frozen drawdown-matched passive benchmark displaces the portfolio
a broad equity-versus-balance drawdown-basis change from this evidence

automatic_followups_not_opened: alternate index weights or US30-only rescue
rolling beta, PCA, lag, timeframe or daily-boundary search
leverage, cost, financing, lot, slot or allocation variant
